findings.claim: COMPOSITOR FIX (2026-06-09 masked-mirror compositor pass). Both maskedMirrorFor and orPlacementFor previously used the raw byte, so placement 6 (the LEFT full-height corner-wall flank, img0 w14 h87, destX255 bias10 destRow40) computed di = 255+10+0x28*40 = 1865 (page col 25, right-of-centre, colliding with its right-side mirror twin 9). findings.claim: The masked-mirror branch (ega.drv FUN_0a93, file 0xbc6..0xd2e) places a HORIZONTALLY-MIRRORED copy of the SOURCE image (arg [bp+0xc]'s placement -> its image descriptor) into the DEST placement's geometry (arg [bp+0x10]). The asm-derived per-row geometry is: cx (bytes/row, [bp-4]) = dest.count; di (dest plane-0 row-0) = dest.destX + dest.bias + 0x28*dest.destRow; siBase (source plane-0 row-0, within seg dataSeg+S.segDelta) = S.srcOffLow + (S.w-1) - dest.bias; row si advance = S.w ([bp-6]); outer rows = S.h; plane stride = S.w*S.h. The inner loop reads cx bytes BACKWARD (`mov al,[si]; dec si`) and runs each through the CS:[0x192] LUT (`cs: xlatb` at 0xc69 = exact 8-bit bit-reverse table) — backward-read + bit-reverse = a horizontal mirror. The 4 planes are at di+0/0x2000/0x4000/0x6000; each plane's source restarts at siBase + p*planeStride (the asm pops si back to siBase between planes, then adds planeStride). [bp+0xe] selects merge: != 0 -> OR-merge (0xc66 branch, `or al,es:[di]; stosb`); 0 -> REPLACE (0xcc3 branch, plain `stosb` — the corridor void carve). VERIFIED BYTE-EXACT: applyMaskedMirror over the engine's captured 'before' region reproduces the engine's captured 'after' region for call#0 (masked 122->122 OR), all 4 planes x 7 rows x 18 bytes = 504 bytes, 100%. The prior pass's failure was NOT geometry — it was (a) validating against a contaminated/transient whole-page snapshot and (b) the gy=118-vs-gy=121 frame mismatch.

asm_anchors.name: ega_masked_mirror_branch
asm_anchors.note: branch entry (arg [bp+0x10] != 0xffff). bx=[bp+0xc]*5+cs:[0x190]=src placement; [bp-2]=imgDescOff+5*src.imgIdx (src image desc); si=[bp+0x10]*5+cs:[0x190]=dst placement.

asm_anchors.name: masked_count_load
asm_anchors.note: al=[si+4]=dst.count -> [bp-4] (cx, per-row byte count). je 0xd27 if zero.

asm_anchors.name: masked_src_desc
asm_anchors.note: [bp-6]=S.w (row si advance); [bp-2]=S.w*S.h (plane stride); ax=S.srcOffLow + (S.w-1) - dst.bias (siBase); ds += S.segDelta.

asm_anchors.name: masked_mode_branch
asm_anchors.note: cmp [bp+0xe],0: jz 0xcc3 (REPLACE) else 0xc66 (OR-merge). cx=[bp-4] per plane; outer cx (rows) = S.h pushed at 0xc57.

asm_anchors.name: masked_or_plane_loop
asm_anchors.note: `mov al,[si]; dec si; cs xlatb; or al,es:[di]; stosb` x4 planes (di+=0x2000, si+=planeStride between planes, si popped back to siBase first).

asm_anchors.name: cs_xlatb_mirror
asm_anchors.note: `2e d7` cs: xlatb; LUT = CS:[0x192] = exact 8-bit bit-reverse table (all 256 verified). backward read + bit-reverse = horizontal mirror.

asm_anchors.name: masked_replace_plane_loop
asm_anchors.note: REPLACE variant: `mov al,[si]; dec si; cs xlatb; stosb` (no OR) — the corridor void carve.

asm_anchors.name: masked_row_advance
asm_anchors.note: di += 0x28 (next dest row); pop ax (=siBase); ax += [bp-6] (S.w); loop 0xc57 (next of S.h rows).
